cues.text: Our plane tickets arrived this morning ... it reminded me how much there is to do before we go.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Let’s write everything down shall we, so we don’t forget anything .
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Yes. Last time we went away we almost forgot to collect our currency from the bank. So let’s start with that.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Good thinking. And wasn’t there an appointment you said you’d got to cancel?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Yes, the hairdresser ... Thanks for reminding me. Can you write that down too? The shop will be closed now, but I’ll do it first thing on Monday.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: OK ... Then, starting on Tuesday we’ve got to take the tablets we got from the pharmacy. We really mustn’t forget to do that, we’re not protected against malaria till we’ve been taking them for at least seven days.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: No, so that’s really important.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: And what about shopping? There’s still a few things we’ve got to buy the next time we’re in town. We need some more sun block don’t we? We’ve only got that factor ten stuff - it won’t be strong enough.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: I’ve already bought that. But what we do still need to get is sunglasses. The ones I’ve got aren’t good enough, and I don’t think yours are either.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: OK ... I’ve noted that down. And I think I’m going to get another bag too. Just a small one. We always seem to come back with more things than we take!
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Shall we get an extra lock for our suitcase as well? Just in case the one we’ve got breaks. They don’t seem to last long.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, they are a bit flimsy. OK ... Right ... Oh yes, and we need an adaptor for our electrical things. Your hair dryer and my shaver ... The plugs on them are bound to be the wrong type.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: We could get one at the airport. They always have them there.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Well I’d rather get it beforehand, so I’m writing it down. And then I think that’s it isn’t it?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: I think so. As far as shopping’s concerned. But we also need to order a taxi to take us to the airport. We should do that well in advance. My sister left it too late and she had to take the train - with that huge suitcase of hers!
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I know, she really struggled with it ...
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Now let’s see ... Your mother said she’d come in regularly while we’re away, so what do we want her to do? I’ll write some instructions and we can give them to her tomorrow.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Good idea. Well ... the cat’s the main thing.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Feed ... the cat ...
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: We ought to leave her the vet’s details as well, just in case there’s a problem.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes. Have you got them handy?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Hang on, I’m just looking ... Yes. His name’s Colin Jefferey.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Is that spelt with a G?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Actually it’s J-E-double F-E-R-E-Y. Quite an unusual spelling, isn’t it?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Mmm. And his number?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Oh treble seven, five nine four ... one two eight. It’s a mobile.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: And you should write down where it is - it’s Fore Street, not sure what number, but it’s next to the bus stop isn’t it?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: That’s not a very good landmark, but it’s on the other side of the road to the church, so I’ll tell her that. Let’s hope she won’t need a vet anyway!
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Yes. Right, apart from that there are the plants to water. Ask her to make sure they don’t dry out.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Oh yes, and I’ve already mentioned the problem with the boiler, and your mum said she’d come round to meet the heating engineer and let him in.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Yes. It’s a lot for her to do, but we really need to get the problem sorted out, and the earliest date I could get an appointment was April the thirtieth.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Isn’t it the day after we go?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Yes - we leave on the twenty-ninth. And she’ll have to hang around till the job’s finished.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Oh well, she won’t mind I’m sure. She likes helping people out.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Yes, she does.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: OK ... That’s it then I think. Unless you can think of anything else?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Not at the moment. Leave the list there and I’ll ...
cues.speaker: Woman
